step.cmd: Sign in at the sign-in page. The server sets the sessions_demo cookie.

Save the sessions_demo cookie four ways. Save it to the sessions_demo and SESSIONS_DEMO_COOKIE environment variables, and to sessions_demo.txt in the output folder. Save it to sessions_demo.txt in a tmp folder next to this file, keeping only the localhost cookie.
Go to the sign-out page, which replaces the cookie.
Load the cookie from sessions_demo.txt in the output folder.
Go to the cookie report, and check that it shows sessions_demo=signed-in.
Go to the sign-out page again, and load the cookie from the SESSIONS_DEMO_COOKIE environment variable.
Go to the cookie report again, and check that it shows sessions_demo=signed-in.
Go to the sign-out page once more, and load the localhost cookie from tmp/sessions_demo.txt.
Go to the cookie report a last time, and check that it shows sessions_demo=signed-in.
